So I have adhd and part of that is struggling with executive dysfunction, and this app is a lifesaver! It is so easy just to push the start button in the morning and then it keeps me on task all throughout my routine. I also really apreciate the ability to add time to a task if you need it and the ability to set multiple reminders for a specific day. All in all, this app is amaizing and premium is well worth the 2.50 a month. I'll definatly be using this for a very long time.
